name: Luhn Checksum (Credit Card)
expression: mod(sum(k, 0, numdigits(n) - 1, if(mod(k, 2) == 0, mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10), digitsum(2 * mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10)))), 10)
description: Computes the Luhn (mod 10) checksum of a number that already ends in its check digit. The number is valid when the result is 0.
notes: Used for payment card numbers and IMEI codes. 79927398713 is the standard valid example. Numbers above 2^53 (16+ digits) lose precision; split longer numbers.

name: Luhn Check Digit
expression: mod(10 - mod(sum(k, 0, numdigits(n) - 1, if(mod(k, 2) == 1, mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10), digitsum(2 * mod(floor(n / 10^k), 10)))), 10), 10)
description: Computes the Luhn check digit to append to n so that the whole number passes the Luhn test.

name: ISBN-10 Check Digit
description: Computes the ISBN-10 check digit from the first nine digits: weights 10 down to 2, modulo 11. A result of 10 is written X.

name: ISBN-13 / EAN-13 Check Digit
description: Computes the check digit of a 13-digit EAN / ISBN-13 barcode from its first twelve digits (alternating weights 1 and 3).

name: UPC-A Check Digit
description: Computes the 12th (check) digit of a UPC-A barcode from its first eleven digits (odd positions weighted 3).
notes: UPC 036000291452 has check digit 2 (leading zero omitted in the input).

name: ISSN Check Digit
description: Computes the check digit of an 8-digit ISSN (serial number) from its first seven digits, weights 8 down to 2 modulo 11 (10 is written X).

name: GS1 Check Digit for GTIN-8
description: Computes the check digit of an 8-digit GTIN (EAN-8) barcode from its first seven digits.

name: Mod 97 Check (ISO 7064, Numeric)
description: Computes the two ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 check digits for a purely numeric reference (the scheme behind IBAN checks).
notes: For 123456789 the check digits are 78. Letters in an IBAN must first be converted to numbers (A = 10, …), and the number must stay below about 9 × 10^13 here.
